notes: AAF-McQuay Group page listing Vision among the group brands (AAF, AAF-McQuay, Herman-Nelson, Incremental, McQuay, Prefex, Remington, Singer, Skyline, Vision). Only style 1 ships: its year/week positions are text-stated and the bold group 0805 confirms year 08, week 05. Styles 2 and 3 are HELD, NOT SHIPPED: single-character year with no era bound on this page (policy-barred; the 1995-1999 bound that lets the sibling AAF file ship its style-2 year comes from the AAF page, not this page, and is not imported) and chart-image-only month. Style 2 list/detail length discrepancy noted (format list '55A1234501', 10 characters; style heading '55A123501', 9 characters). Shipped style 1 shape (4 letters + 9 digits) is disjoint from held style shapes (digit-led), so no shape-collision hold applies. Parent per page: AAF-McQuay Group, Inc., a subsidiary of Daikin.

styles.notes: Page: year = 5th & 6th characters combined, week = 7th & 8th characters combined, converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example shown spaced as 'AUB U 08 05 00386'; normalized form used here.
